items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 13:1
items.html: For the circles that had already come out by the coupling made upon the new screen of the second restriction — behold, they were compelled to encircle around the central point of the second restriction, which is at the place of the Chazeh of the Partzuf NHY of AK. Hence, the place of the conclusion of the feet of AK is much more important than the place of the point of the second restriction, because it is far from the new central point. Therefore it is discerned that the new circles pushed the vessels back to their place above — that is, to the place of the Chazeh of the Partzuf TNHY of AK. (Item 6, and in the Ohr Pnimi at the subheading "and they drove them out").
